def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split at the full-width divider and identify the shared color in the
    # two panels. Replace shared-color coincidences with 3.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    if rows:
        sep = min(rows, key=lambda r: abs(r - (h - 1) / 2))
        a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
        shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        color = min(shared)
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(min(len(a), len(b)))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep = min(cols, key=lambda c: abs(c - (w - 1) / 2))
    a, b = [row[:sep] for row in grid], [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = min(shared)
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(min(len(a[0]), len(b[0])))] for r in range(h)]
